title: Zvapupu Zvakaparara
intro: Kare kare, nzanga yaigara munzvimbo yaiva pakati pemadzimambo. Muprofita wavo akavadana kuti vaende kunzira yechokwadi, asi vakaramba vasina kutenda uye vachidzvinyirirwa. Nyaya iyi inoguma nekurangwa naMwari. Unogona kuziva rudzi urwu neramangwana rarwo kubva pazviratidzo zviri pazasi here?
clues: Vanhu vakaramba yambiro yakauya nemumwe wevatumwa vavo.
Mutumwa akatidana kuti tinamate Allah chete uye akatinyevera nezvehuori.
Kudarika kwedu kwaiva kuramba muporofita akatumwa pakati pedu nekururama.
Takanga tisina chokwadi nesimba remutumwa uye takamupomera mhosva yekunyengera.
Chirango chakatibata patakanga tichigara zvakanaka mudzimba dzedu.
Takaparadzwa nekuda kwekuramba muporofita wedu nekutambudza vatendi.
arabic: وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًۭا فَقَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱرْجُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
verse: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shuʿayb, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh and expect the Last Day and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption." (29:36)
